description: Responsive data-grid redesign to eliminate heavy left-right scrolling: freeze the first (Employee) column on the wide table and add a stacked mobile card view below md. Both views read the SAME server data and preserve ALL functionality. Structurally independent of FEAT-001/002, but ordered after them so the generalized SecretField/SecretEditCell and masked DL cell already exist to reuse in both views; run after FEAT-002.
steps: src/app/admin/grid/page.tsx: keep ALL data fetching + access computation server-side in page.tsx. Freeze the first Employee column: apply position: sticky; left: 0 to its <th> and <td> (via Tailwind sticky left-0 + an explicit bg to stay opaque) with a right-edge shadow to signal the freeze. Keep the existing sticky-top header. Use explicit z-index layering: frozen body cell below the sticky header row, the top-left header corner cell highest. Because the frozen body cell needs an opaque background (so scrolled content doesn't bleed through), render the approved-row highlight on it via an inset-ring token (e.g. ring-inset ring-emerald-500/30) instead of relying on the row's bg-emerald-500/10 showing through.

src/app/admin/grid/page.tsx: wrap the existing <table> so it only shows at md and up (e.g. the scroll container becomes hidden md:block, or the table hidden md:table) and add a md:hidden stacked card list rendering the same employees. Each card: a header row with the employee name (linked when canOpenDetailsFor) + duplicate badge + a status pill, then label/value rows for the visible columns including the masked IDs (reuse SecretField/SecretEditCell with the same field/label/canReveal as the table) and the per-row doc/action links (DocLinks, UploadCell, PinConfirmButton for active/archive, approve/hr-reviewed forms). Reuse the existing cell components; do not duplicate business logic.

If page.tsx grows unwieldy, extract presentational pieces into new client/server components under src/app/admin/grid/ (e.g. EmployeeCard.tsx) that receive already-computed props (masked strings, booleans, employeeId) — never ciphertext. Keep edit cells, PIN reveals, doc links, duplicate badge, approved highlight, and archived handling working in BOTH views. Per-instance reveal state across the two mounted views is acceptable (SecretField has no mount-time side effect).
acceptance_criteria: At viewport width >= 768px the full table renders with the Employee column frozen on horizontal scroll (right-edge shadow visible) and the header still sticky on vertical scroll; the approved-row highlight is visible on the opaque frozen cell.

At viewport width < 768px the table is hidden and a stacked card list renders instead, one card per employee, with name+status-pill header and label/value rows including masked IDs with working eye reveal and the per-row doc/action links.

All grid functionality (inline edit cells, PIN-gated reveal/save/clear, doc links, duplicate badge, approved highlight, archived handling, status/approve toggles) works in both the table and the card view.
No client component receives raw or ciphertext secrets; only server-computed masked strings.
verification: From c:\Sir project\ontask\.worktrees\security-pin run: npx tsc --noEmit  (zero errors)
From the same dir run: npm run build  (exit 0)
Manual/visual check (document it in findings): narrow the viewport < 768px -> card list shows, table hidden; widen >= 768px -> table shows with frozen first column.
findings:
DONE. Verification green: `npx tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; `npm run build` exit 0 (/admin/grid compiles as a dynamic route). No schema/migration change.

IMPLEMENTATION (src/app/admin/grid/page.tsx only; all data fetching + access computation stays server-side; no new child component needed, so NONE added):

1) buildRow(e) helper (new, inside GridPage before return): builds EVERY visible cell for one employee ONCE and returns { nameNode, cells, isDuplicate, name }. `cells` is an ordered RowCell[] = { key, label, node } produced via a `push(key,label,node)` that only pushes when show(key) is true — so the exact same show/editable/approvable decisions, computed strings (name/address/certNames), and cell components (SecretField/SecretEditCell with identical field/label/canReveal, SiteCell, EditableCell, AddressCell, RateCell, FrcCell, FlagCell, DocLinks, UploadCell, and the approve/hr-reviewed forms + active/archive PinConfirmButton) feed BOTH views. Business logic is NOT duplicated — only the wrapping markup (<td> vs <dt>/<dd>) differs. The legacy inline per-cell table JSX was removed.

2) FROZEN first column (table, md+): the scroll container is now `hidden max-h-[75vh] overflow-auto ... md:block` (both-axis scroll with a sticky header). thead is `sticky top-0 z-20 bg-slate-900/95`. The Employee <th> uses thFrozen = th + `sticky left-0 z-30 bg-slate-900/95` + right-edge shadow (top-left corner highest). The Employee <td> uses tdFrozenBase = td + `sticky left-0 z-10` + same right-edge shadow `shadow-[2px_0_6px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6)]`, with an OPAQUE `bg-slate-900` so horizontally-scrolled cells can't bleed through. z-layering is explicit: corner z-30 > header row z-20 > frozen body cell z-10 > scrolling body. Because the opaque bg hides the row's bg-emerald-500/10, the approved-row highlight is rendered on the frozen cell via an inset-ring token `ring-inset ring-1 ring-emerald-500/30` (per spec), while the <tr> keeps bg-emerald-500/10 for the non-frozen cells.

3) STACKED CARD view (<md): a new `md:hidden` list renders one card per employee from the SAME buildRow() output — header = nameNode (name link when canOpenDetailsFor, duplicate badge, per-employee docs download) on a bordered header row, then a <dl> grid of label/value rows for every visible column, including the masked IDs (SecretField/SecretEditCell reused with identical field/label/canReveal) and the per-row DocLinks/UploadCell/PinConfirmButton/approve+hr-reviewed forms. Approved cards get an emerald border + inset ring; the empty state renders a card-styled message. Both views are mounted at once (one CSS-hidden); per-instance reveal state is safe because SecretField/SecretEditCell have no mount-time side effect (documented in those components from FEAT-001).

SECURITY: no client cell receives raw/ciphertext — buildRow passes only server-computed masked strings (maskSsn/maskLast4(safeDecrypt(...))) and booleans/ids, identical to the pre-FEAT-003 table.

VIEWPORT SPOT-CHECK (static/responsive-class verification — no browser/E2E harness exists in this repo, so checked via the emitted Tailwind breakpoint classes rather than a live pixel capture): the table container is `hidden md:block` and the card list is `md:hidden` — mutually exclusive at the 768px breakpoint, so >=768px shows ONLY the frozen-column table and <768px shows ONLY the card list. Frozen column: `sticky left-0` + opaque `bg-slate-900` + right-edge shadow on <th>/<td>; sticky header: thead `sticky top-0`; z-order 30/20/10 as above. tsc + build both green confirm the JSX/types are sound. A live pixel confirmation of the shadow/scroll feel was NOT run (no headless-browser tooling available).
